scope: The website snapshot has 22 selectable keyboard profiles. The official 1.10.4 Mac app ships those 22 keyboard folders plus two additional keyboard folders (Blip and Glyph), native mouse assets, and UI audio. The exact website Keychron Brown OGG sprite is available as a separate optional import.

reuse.status: No blanket audio license was found for all imported files.
reuse.named_mac_app_permission_only: The app attribution file says redistribution is permitted as part of the Keeby macOS app for Akko Piano Pro (Alice), Keychron K2 Max Brown (Himanshu), and IQUNIX MQ80 (Alex). It does not state permission outside that app.
reuse.personal_import: This script writes to a user-selected local sound-pack directory. Do not ship the source audio in the repository or package.

profiles.name: Quirky Blip
profiles.label_inference: Separate 'quirky' brand and 'blip' switch-id strings in the native app binary; concatenated label and runtime menu not verified.

profiles.name: Quirky Glyph
profiles.label_inference: Separate 'quirky' brand and 'glyph' switch-id strings in the native app binary; concatenated label and runtime menu not verified.

mouse_snappy_profile.name: Mouse Snappy (NovelKeys Cream keyboard)
mouse_snappy_profile.mapping_note: Exact Snappy left-button recordings map to Linux BTN_LEFT. The native archive has no distinct Snappy right/middle recordings; those slots use the exact generic mouse_down/up series as a documented Linux fallback.
